messages:
Kai: Tiny poll: weve been using color codenames for micro-models. Which color-name should be the official alias for the low-latency distill? React or reply.
Options:
• :fire: Ember
• :large_blue_circle: Azure
• :herb: Sage
• :white_square_button: Slate

Nina: :fire: Ember for the speed vibes.

Omar: leaning Azure. Feels crisp and stable.

Yara: Sage for the gentle green energy. also looks nice on a sticker.

DevOps-bot: FYI: if Ember wins, infra-tagging will be ember-lt for low-tier.

Omar: :thumbsup: fine by me.

Nina: anyone else have write-ins?

Yara: small write-in: "Dawn" but not fighting over it.

poll-bot: Poll closed (15m). Results: Ember 2, Azure 1, Sage 1, Slate 0, Write-ins: Dawn 1. Ember chosen as official alias :tada:

Kai: Perfect. I'll add the alias mapping and update the quickstart with ember-lt. thanks for the quick votes everyone!
